title: Structured triage & prioritization: SDK enterprise signals (language coverage, auth, streaming ergonomics)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
This ticket captures a structured intake and prioritization plan for SDK and client-library requests coming from enterprise customers. Focus areas: 1) language coverage gaps for Dedicated/Private deployments, 2) standardized authentication patterns (SSO/SAML/OAuth2 token rotation, key management), and 3) streaming ergonomics (client-side backpressure, reconnect semantics, and higher-level helpers).

Objective:
Create a reproducible triage rubric so PMs can (a) rank requests by business value and engineering cost, (b) produce a targeted roadmap for Q2 that addresses the highest-risk enterprise blocks, and (c) deliver minimal viable SDK changes for pilot customers within 4 weeks.

Proposed rubric highlights:
- Customer signal weight: enterprise contract value, compliance requirements, and active pilots (x2 multiplier).
- Implementation cost: existing bindings, runtime compatibility, and test coverage (low/medium/high).
- Security & compliance delta: whether change needs KMS/HSM or SSO changes (security review required).
- Observability & maintenance: expected long-term maintenance burden.

Initial prioritization suggestion (based on intake log through 2026-03-05):
- Priority A: Java and .NET (C#) SDK updates for OAuth2 token refresh + SSO integration (2 large enterprise customers blocked).
- Priority B: Go SDK: streaming client helpers and reconnect/backpressure primitives (platform team request for Dedicated clusters).
- Priority C: Rust bindings exploratory spike (low immediate demand, but strategic for infra teams).

Deliverables:
- Clear triage rubric document and scoring sheet (Confluence).
- Backlog tickets broken out by language and feature (auth/streaming/docs).
- Prototype Java auth module and Go streaming helpers with sample apps for validation.
- Metrics: # of enterprise customer blocks cleared, reduction in integration support tickets, SDK adoption in Dedicated customers.

Acceptance criteria and owner-level decisions are enumerated below. Links to design notes, PRs, and intake spreadsheet included.
